notes.title: Ammunition Reload System Optimization
notes.content:
New "Ready Rack" Mechanism
A more realistic reloading workflow has been implemented:

When shells are stored in the ready rack, reload speed is significantly faster.

Once the ready rack is depleted, shells are transferred from other racks, resulting in a slightly longer reload time.

The default reload time for ready rack shells has been adjusted for better balance.
This mechanism adds strategic depth to ammunition management and creates a more realistic and tactical firing rhythm.

Ammo Rack System Upgrade

The number of shells displayed in ammo rack models must now match the configured data (requires mod adaptation).

Modders can now define custom ammo rack usage order for more flexible reload logic.

Main and secondary gun ammo racks are now separated, allowing independent configuration and behavior control.

The Tank Workshop now supports custom ammunition count settings and rack-module binding.

Shell types with capacity limits will no longer trigger the fast reload behavior for the first round.

Fixed an issue where failure to carry Shell Type 1 prevented drum magazine reloading.

Tank Workshop Enhancements
Turrets and gun barrels can now be linked to specific modules such as gunner, loader, ammo rack, and elevation mechanism, enabling greater flexibility in module configuration.

Armor Monitor Improvements
Added a new "Filter by Module Type" feature, allowing players to display specific components such as engine, ammo rack, and fuel tank for more efficient identification.

AI Behavior Enhancements
AI now supports patrol waypoints for naval units, enabling automatic navigation along water-based routes and improving AI behavior in naval combat scenarios.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where turret rotation direction could behave abnormally in some cases.

Increased the default lifetime of slow-speed shells.

notes.title: Overpressure mechanism
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for "Panzer War"! In this update, we have implemented the Kingery-Bulmash formula to achieve a more realistic overpressure mechanism for explosives.

Overpressure Mechanism: With the Kingery-Bulmash formula, we have updated the overpressure mechanism generated by explosions. The overpressure mechanism refers to the phenomenon where the pressure wave generated by an explosion exceeds the ambient pressure, creating a momentary high-pressure zone that impacts and damages surrounding objects. In the game, this will more realistically cause damage to members, making the combat experience more immersive and impactful.

We believe this update will greatly enhance your gaming experience, and we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!

Thank you for your continued support and passion!

Happy gaming,
The Development Team at WindyVerse Pte. Ltd.

notes.title: Fuel Tank Fire Damage & Smoke Grenades Feature
notes.content:
New Experimental Features Now Live on Steam!
We are thrilled to bring you a suite of new experimental features aimed at elevating your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

Fuel Tank Fire Damage: Experience increased realism and tactical depth as nearby modules progressively suffer damage when a fuel tank ignites.

Fire Extinguisher Functionality: Address fires swiftly with our new fire extinguisher feature, helping you safeguard your gear and maintain a competitive edge.

Smoke Grenades Feature (Single Player Only; Multiplayer Coming June): Currently available for single player, smoke grenades allow for strategic cover and evasive maneuvers. Excitingly, this feature will be extended to multiplayer mode in June, broadening your tactical options in team settings.

Quick Tactical Commands (Multiplayer): Enhance team coordination and strategy execution with quick tactical commands, designed to improve communication and operational efficiency.

These features are still in the experimental phase, and we greatly value your input. Engage with these new additions and let us know your thoughts to aid in their development!

notes.title: Panzer War : Definitive Edition for Beta Test!
notes.content:
After 5 month of hard development, Panzer War and Cry of War has been updated to brand new version! And the combination of two games is called Panzer War : Panzer War : Definitive Edition now. This version uses the new rendering features. And it is compatible with old mods. This news will introduce all the new features one by one.

[b]New Lighting for tanks[/b]

The tank textures are re-made with PBR technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/a7c401199511c81c0e0dd95fd651815554ab0805.png[/img]

You can set the level of dirty in camouflage settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/be5e27a721ae666196d256bb3cd98e8fd14a3480.png[/img]

[b]Module-Based Mechanics[/b]

The Panzer War and Cry of War are combined. So module-based mechanics have been added to PanzerWar:DE. It includes module-based damage mechanic and hp-based damage mechanic. You can select different damage mechanic in the game option. The game uses the new rendering pipelines. The module-based damage is similar to War Thunder. It calculates how shell damage internal modules and gives the x-ray replay. The hp-based damage is similar to World of Tanks. 

[/b]
[olist]
[*] Different ammos damage internal modules differently.
[*] Ammo count affects the size of ammo shell.
[*] Not all the tanks are available for module-based mode.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/63ec08718ecce254c2db7bac07831f735874673e.png[/img]

[b]Heat Thermal[/b]

You can open Heat Thermal on modern tanks by pressing Z button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/b925953d151706a03cb8803c50dd3026512a6472.png[/img]

[b]Armor Inspector[/b]

You can view armor by new armor inspector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/e331d3869aee1e6ea36813c9c6afc40479a83c6d.png[/img]

FAQ

1. Why is my subscribed mod missing?

To accelerate mod development, some of the community mods are assembled together. If you do not want bot to play some of them, you can ban it in the game setting.  

Subscribe it from : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2433178511

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/4790a8624a71cea6ce74cea85ac3911cd4133b92.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]New Tank![/b][/h1]

One new WW2 tank, Char Bis 1, has been added to the game. It features with 75 mm main gun and 37 mm main gun on its turret. Of course, both of the guns can shoot in the game.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/240d02f8609d0aa3c4bd9e02cd248cf49306b332.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]New Mode[/b]
[/h1]What’s more, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Cry of War.

In Cry of War, you can set your nation, and the range of vehicle you can select will be limited due to your nation. And that is a non-respawn game mode.
 



As to the Panzer War,[u] the new game mode RTS mode has joined the desktop version.[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/8d2801f87c475b0cff6a0c50abacada3713f4285.jpg[/img]
The control of RTS mode: (The tutorial has not been added to the game now. So look at the following control guidance)

[list]
[*] W A S D to move the camera. Q E to rotate the camera.
[*] Left mouse: click to select a single unit.
[*] Drag mouse with holding the left mouse to draw a selection box to select units
[*] Right mouse: click to attack the enemy
[*] Drag mouse with holding the right mouse to draw an arrow for where the selected units look for.
[*] Hold left ctrl and left click on the map to attack any place on the map.
[/list]

A new mission called “Fury” is added to the Panzer War.
In this mission, you will be the commander of four Sherman tanks and you will encounter the Tiger.
 

Also, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Panzer War. It is an RTS game mode. The goal in this mode is to destroy all enemy units.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/200fe1913b2f43ceeb25f3c7e9d1a6872e37c306.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/7fe89231e5aadaaa258e12961fa0326386cdc237.png[/img]

As a work that has been in existence for 4 years, "Panzer War" has almost condensed all my efforts and also embodies the feelings of the majority of players. 

For the past 4 years, "Panzer War" has been more than just a game for me. It is a dream, a persistence, and I want to show the most exciting world to all the players waiting.

And now, you can also play the original version of Panzer War from Steam.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/32842f93939ba68390a4480aa4640c9f33236969.png[/img]

notes.title: New graphic,optimization,mechanics in Fundamental Update 1.02
notes.content:

It has been two weeks since the 1.01 version update. The developer didn't just stop. Now, it's time to see something brand new.

[h1]Dynamic dirty effects[/h1]
Now,tank will become dirty as the time passes by instead of being dirty at all the time.
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/dbc9236e997f6c57e19a58b8914e1cf975c61485.jpg[/img]

What's more, it can be different with different environments.(Snow map hasn't been done yet)
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/a244f4be6a8c13c231f49f00f2beb72c1592c252.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/6c1329391699fa9badb45ee9b874324daefaabdb.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Graphic[/h1]

The rendering of the scene has changed a lot.

[h1]New Mechanic[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/0e6db5c5f69d98585b14f5735025b1f6149b6400.jpg[/img]
When you are trying Mark IV, you can switch the turret by clicking F1 and F2 now.
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/f27ca24fa3e6a2b09ad1836a92f2af55aa7160e4.jpg[/img]

Let's battle!

notes.title: Game Update 1.01.2 Welcome Real Mark.IV
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/93dffc641bc7726e1b9b102858be1c9d21fc18e7.jpg[/img]

The legendary history of tank started with "TANK" - Mark Tank. And now, our developer has fixed the left side of the turret! You can fire at the enemy with two cannons.

With the update, there are other contents. 
[h1]Contents:[/h1]
Voice system has returned to the game.
The hit indicator is added.
The camera will shake when fired.

[h1]Bug fixed:[/h1]
FullScreen can be set now.

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Update 1.01.1 Workshop Supports!
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
With great efforts on improving the game,the workshop is introduced in the latest game update.

Now,you can visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798840/workshop/]Workshop[/url] and subscribe your favourite contents. Once you subscribe the content ,game will load mods automatically.

[h1]Spotlight[/h1]
The official has released a series of camouflage mods in the workshop.You can subscribe now.

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/13955ec89141cdf073c2e044a79a19c516bdf71c.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[h1] Fundamental Update[/h1]
It has been 4 months since the first release. And now, it comes the first game contetn update. Here is the detail of the game update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/e3d3ac690eac51bcc818502ca3b11e732e4ee82b.jpg[/img]

Graphic has been improved.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/bfa13407099f743b32796636b2a9c0b75be9c12e.jpg[/img]

The internal module has been improved.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/76160b4b45e0b756c32a4944b3f3dbdcef88d349.jpg[/img]


The small objects in the scene can be destroyed now.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/464afa4f91204e0b0f5650534deda1ae9313fd5a.png[/img]

Enjoy the update,plz!

In the followed month, I will focus on the game optimization, scene detail improvements and custom map support with workshop.

notes.title: Feb.22 DevLog
notes.content:
There will be some new features to be added into the game in the following updates.

The initial version of the release is just a simple code transplant. In the future, we will add more contents to the game.

First,we will add all of the WW1 tanks. And we will focus on creating new huge battlefields.What’s more, we will add missions.
